# ViaNJ

> ViaNJ is an iPhone app for NJ Transit rail departures, tickets, checkout, recovery, and Apple Wallet.

## Website

- Homepage: https://www.vianj.app/
- Privacy policy: https://www.vianj.app/privacy-policy

## App

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/vianj-trains-tickets/id6754224152
- Platform: iOS

## Core features

- Live NJ Transit departures
- Boarding status, service alerts, favorite stations, and track predictions
- Ticket organization, activation, receipt recovery, and Apple Wallet
- Optional ViaNJ Pro integrated ticket purchasing, automatic import, and purchase recovery

Track predictions are estimates. Riders should confirm final track assignments on official station boards and announcements before boarding.

ViaNJ Pro does not include NJ Transit fares. NJ Transit sells and charges each fare separately. ViaNJ is not affiliated with or endorsed by NJ Transit.
